text: The present applications concern the applicants' arrests in relation to their intention to participate in peaceful demonstrations.
The present applications concern administrative proceedings against the applicants in relation to their intention to participate in peaceful demonstrations.
The applicants alleged that their arrest had been an unlawful interference with their right to freedom of assembly under Article 11 of the Convention.
The applicants alleged that their conviction had been an unlawful interference with their right to freedom of assembly under Article 11 of the Convention.
The applicants alleged that their arrest had been contrary to the guarantees of Article 5 of the Convention.
The applicants alleged that their arrest had been contrary to the guarantees of Article 6 of the Convention.
The applicants alleged that their conviction had been contrary to the guarantees of Article 5 of the Convention.
The applicants alleged that their conviction had been contrary to the guarantees of Article 6 of the Convention.
Some applicants raised complaints under Article 10 of the Convention.
The applicants were represented by Mr R. Mustafazade, a lawyer based in Azerbaijan.
The applicants were represented by Mr A. Mustafayev, a lawyer based in Azerbaijan.
The Government were represented by their Agent, Mr Ç. Əsgərov.

The circumstances relating to the applicants' arrest and custody are similar to those in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (application nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, paragraphs 5-55, judgment of 11 February 2016).

The circumstances relating to the subsequent administrative proceedings against the applicants are similar to those in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (application nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, paragraphs 5-55, judgment of 11 February 2016).

The circumstances relating to the applicants' arrest and custody are similar to those in Huseynov and Others v. Azerbaijan (application nos. 34262/14 and 5 others, paragraphs 4-30, judgment of 24 November 2016).

The circumstances relating to the subsequent administrative proceedings against the applicants are similar to those in Huseynov and Others v. Azerbaijan (application nos. 34262/14 and 5 others, paragraphs 4-30, judgment of 24 November 2016).
The applicants were opposition-oriented activists.
The applicants intended to participate in peaceful demonstrations planned for 8 April 2012.
The applicants intended to participate in peaceful demonstrations planned for 22 April 2012.
The applicants were arrested on various dates while distributing leaflets inviting people to participate in the authorised demonstration of 8 April 2012.
The applicants were arrested on various dates while distributing leaflets inviting people to participate in the authorised demonstration of 22 April 2012.
The applicants were subsequently convicted under the Code of Administrative Offences to various administrative detention terms.
